SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SHIELD_BASH.title: Shield Bash
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-CRUSHING_BLOW.title: Crushing Blow
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-ARMOR_SPLITTER.title: Armor Splitter
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-ICE_WIND.title: Ice Wind
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-ICE_WIND.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} [blue]frost[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
Apply {ChillPower:diff()} [gold]Chill[/gold] to ALL enemies.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-PIERCING_THRUST.title: Piercing Thrust
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-FLAT_STRIKE.title: Flat Strike
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SWEEPING_BLOW.title: Sweeping Blow
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SWEEPING_BLOW.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
Apply {StaggerPower:diff()} [gold]Stagger[/gold] to ALL enemies.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-FROST_STRIKE.title: Frost Strike
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-AGAINST_ALL_ODDS.title: Against All Odds
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-AGAINST_ALL_ODDS.descript:
Costs no ◆.
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Double if you are [gold]Tired[/gold].
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-WRATH_HAMMER.title: Wrath Hammer
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-CATCH_BREATH.title: Catch Breath
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-RAISE_SHIELD.title: Raise Shield
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-RAISE_SHIELD.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
If you have [gold]Plating[/gold], gain {PlatingBonus:diff()} more.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-STEADY_STANCE.title: Steady Stance
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SMOTHER_FLAMES.title: Smother Flames
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BATTLE_CRY.title: Battle Cry
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-CHANGE_GRIP.title: Change Grip
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-CHANGE_GRIP.description: Your next Attack this turn costs no ◆ and deals {GripPower:diff()} more damage.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-CLOSE_RANKS.title: Close Ranks
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-TEMPERING.title: Tempering
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-TEMPERING.description: At the start of your turn, regain {TemperingPower:diff()} more ◆.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-FROSTBLOOD.title: Frostblood
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-FROSTBLOOD.description:
Gain [gold]Frost Resistance[/gold] {FrostResistancePower:diff()}.
Chill you apply is increased by {FrostbloodPower:diff()}. Chill on you wears off entirely.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-UNBREAKABLE.title: Unbreakable
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-UNBREAKABLE.description:
Gain {PlatingPower:diff()} [gold]Plating[/gold].
You can no longer be [gold]Staggered[/gold].
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SPARKS.title: Sparks
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SPARKS.description:
[gold]Retain[/gold].
Deal {Damage:diff()} [purple]shock[/purple] damage. Apply {StaticPower:diff()} [gold]Static[/gold].
While retained, gains 1 damage each turn.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-FIREBOLT.title: Firebolt
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-FIRE_RUNE.title: Fire Rune
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-FIRE_RUNE.description: The next enemy to attack you takes {FireRunePower:diff()} [red]fire[/red] damage and half as much [gold]Burning[/gold].
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-FLAME_CLOAK.title: Flame Cloak
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-FIREBALL.title: Fireball
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-FIREBALL.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} [red]fire[/red] damage to ALL enemies.
Apply {BurningPower:diff()} [gold]Burning[/gold] to ALL enemies.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-ICE_SPIKE.title: Ice Spike
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-ICE_SPIKE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} [blue]frost[/blue] damage. Double against a [gold]Frozen[/gold] enemy.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BALL_LIGHTNING.title: Ball Lightning
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BALL_LIGHTNING.descriptio: Deal {Damage:diff()} [purple]shock[/purple] damage. Jumps to 2 more enemies, 3 less damage each jump.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-WALL_OF_FLAMES.title: Wall of Flames
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-WALL_OF_FLAMES.descriptio: At the start of your next {FlameWallPower:diff()} turns, apply 6 [gold]Burning[/gold] to ALL enemies.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BLIZZARD.title: Blizzard
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BLIZZARD.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} [blue]frost[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
Apply {ChillPower:diff()} [gold]Chill[/gold] to ALL enemies.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-CHAIN_LIGHTNING.title: Chain Lightning
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-CHAIN_LIGHTNING.descripti:
Burn away all ✦ of an enemy mage.
Deal {Damage:diff()} [purple]shock[/purple] damage to a random enemy {Hits} times.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-METEOR.title: Meteor
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-METEOR.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} [red]fire[/red] damage, {Splash:diff()} to other enemies.
Apply {BurningPower:diff()} [gold]Burning[/gold] to ALL enemies.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-ICE_TOMB.title: Ice Tomb
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-ICE_TOMB.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} [blue]frost[/blue] damage. The enemy is [gold]Frozen[/gold] and skips its intent (bosses: 5 [gold]Stagger[/gold]).
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-HEALING_LIGHT.title: Healing Light
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-HEALING_LIGHT.description:
Heal {Heal:diff()} HP.
[gold]Exhausts[/gold] on the 3rd play in a combat.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-LESSER_WARD.title: Lesser Ward
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SUNBEAM.title: Sunbeam
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SUNBEAM.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} [gold]light[/gold] damage (double against undead, spirits and the Abyss).
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-POISON_SPRAY.title: Poison Spray
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-TURN_UNDEAD.title: Turn Undead
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-TURN_UNDEAD.description: Undead with {Threshold:diff()} HP or less are destroyed. Deal {Damage:diff()} [gold]light[/gold] damage to ALL other enemies; surviving undead skip their intent.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-PESTILENCE.title: Pestilence
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SUNBURST.title: Sunburst
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SUNBURST.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} [gold]light[/gold] damage to ALL enemies (double against undead).
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-GREATER_WARD.title: Greater Ward
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-GREATER_WARD.description: Gain {SpellShieldPower:diff()} [gold]Ward[/gold]. You can't be [gold]Paralyzed[/gold] this combat.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-OAKFLESH.title: Oakflesh
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-TELEKINESIS.title: Telekinesis
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-STONEFLESH.title: Stoneflesh
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-PARALYZE.title: Paralyze
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-PARALYZE.description: An enemy with 120 HP or less skips its intent. Bosses and the Unshakeable get 5 [gold]Stagger[/gold] instead.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SPELL_ABSORPTION.title: Absorb Spell
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SPELL_ABSORPTION.descript: Gain {SpellAbsorptionPower:diff()} [gold]Spell Absorption[/gold] until your next turn.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-DRAGONHIDE.title: Dragonhide
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MASS_PARALYSIS.title: Mass Paralysis
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MASS_PARALYSIS.descriptio: ALL non-boss enemies skip their intent. Bosses get 5 [gold]Stagger[/gold].
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SPECTRAL_BLADE.title: Spectral Blade
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BOUND_BLADE.title: Bound Blade
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BOUND_BLADE.description: Add a [gold]Spectral Blade[/gold] to your hand.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-CONJURE_SPIRIT_WOLF.title: Spirit Wolf
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-CONJURE_SPIRIT_WOLF.descr: Summon a [gold]Spirit Wolf[/gold] with {SummonHp:diff()} HP. It deals 4 damage at the end of your turn.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-CONJURE_FLAME_ATRONACH.de: Summon a [gold]Flame Atronach[/gold] with {SummonHp:diff()} HP (5 [red]fire[/red] damage and 2 [gold]Burning[/gold] each turn). Gain 2 [gold]Flame Cloak[/gold].
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-CONJURE_FROST_ATRONACH.de: Summon a [gold]Frost Atronach[/gold] with {SummonHp:diff()} HP. Attackers get 2 [gold]Chill[/gold].
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-CONJURE_STORM_ATRONACH.de: Summon a [gold]Storm Atronach[/gold] with {SummonHp:diff()} HP. Deals 6 [purple]shock[/purple] damage to ALL enemies each turn.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BANISH.title: Banish
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BANISH.description: Destroy an enemy minion. Otherwise deal {Damage:diff()} [purple]magic[/purple] damage.
